thesis_title: Building a Word-Level American Sign Language Recognition System: A Multi-Architecture Design and Evaluation Study
task: Word-level (isolated sign) American Sign Language recognition from video

institution.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

dataset.name: ASL Citizen
dataset.license: Microsoft Research License Terms -- non-commercial research use; data may not be redistributed.
dataset.split_policy: Official signer-independent train / validation / test splits

sources.cached_videos, glosses_in_cache: r3d_18 notebook manifest cell output (63,550 entries, 2,731 classes)
sources.subset_1000: r3d_18 notebook PILOT_MODE cell output; identical split sizes in all 1000-class runs (test n=12,560)
sources.typical_video: r3d_18 notebook probe_video() over 300 random clips

swin3d_t_1000.description: Video Swin Transformer (tiny), Kinetics-400 initialised, fine-tuned end-to-end on 16-frame signer crops resized to 224x224. Shifted-window self-attention over space and time.

r3d18_dualstream_1000.description: Capstone B (v9) model: Kinetics-400 R3D-18 3D-CNN on 112x112 signer crops (layer4 fine-tuned) fused with a MediaPipe landmark stream, followed by a 3-layer Transformer encoder.

geometry_transformer_1000.description: v10 geometry-only model: 58 MediaPipe landmarks (hands, arms, eyebrows) + velocity per frame, linear embedding, sinusoidal positions, 3-layer Transformer encoder, mean pooling.

stgcn_1000.description: Spatial-temporal graph convolutional network over the 58-landmark skeleton (hand bones, arm chain, eyebrows) plus a learned adjacency; 7 graph/temporal-conv blocks.

geometry_transformer_300.description: v10 geometry-only Transformer trained on the 300 most frequent glosses.

geometry_transformer_500.description: v10 geometry-only Transformer trained on the 500 most frequent glosses.

geometry_transformer_1200.description: v10 geometry-only Transformer trained on the 1200 most frequent glosses.

training_hardware: Kaggle notebooks, NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPUs (Swin-T: 2x T4, 6.1 h)
deployment: Streamlit Community Cloud (CPU), weights downloaded on demand from Hugging Face
